r580_178_04_source_facts.fact: KernelSMDebuggerSession maps public 0x83DE0309 to the fixed-size exception-mask method; that wrapper requests internal control 0x83DE0405.
The R580 debugger internal-control implementation delegates to gpuresInternalControlForward_IMPL, while its internal-object-handle implementation returns NV01_NULL_OBJECT.
gpuresInternalControlForward_IMPL passes RES_GET_CLIENT_HANDLE and the virtual internal-object handle to GPU_GET_PHYSICAL_RMAPI(pGpu)->Control.

The monolithic physical API fast path directly invokes a cached subdevice method only when hClient equals the GPU internal client and hObject equals its internal subdevice; otherwise it delegates to the internal RM_API control.
rmapi.c installs rmapiControl as the internal RM_API Control entrypoint. The implementation body is in nv-kernel.o_binary, not the inspected C sources.

GNU nm/objdump identify rmapiControl and _rmapiRmControl in the R580 binary; rmapiControlWithSecInfo relocates to _rmapiRmControl, and _rmapiRmControl contains relocations to serverControl. This establishes a source-to-binary control route, not the exact arguments or runtime branch for the observed V100 call.

The inspected Resource Server serverControl path calls clientGetResourceRef with RmCtrlParams.hObject; clientGetResourceRef returns NV_ERR_OBJECT_NOT_FOUND when the client resource map lacks that handle.

r595_blackwell_route.capture_phase: context only; no numerical kernel executed in this capture
r595_blackwell_route.hardware_fact: The stock PC3 RTX 5080/R595.99.02 capture resolved public 0x83DE0309 to a live GT200_DEBUGGER and recorded syscall/RM status 0; the same capture reports GPU firmware 595.99.02.
r595_blackwell_route.interpretation: GSP is a plausible explanation for the RTX path, but the capture does not prove that this specific request traversed rpcRmApiControl_GSP.
r595_blackwell_route.source_fact: rpcRmApiSetup selects rpcRmApiControl_GSP only when IS_GSP_CLIENT(pGpu); the GSP RM-control routine serializes hClient, hObject, command and parameters into RPC and returns the GSP RM status.
r595_blackwell_route.status: source-plus-prior-hardware-observation; exact dispatch branch not runtime-traced
